استعذين (form X)
# اِسْتَعْذَيْنَ (istaʕḏayna) /is.taʕ.ðaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اُسْتُعْذِينَ (ustuʕḏīna) /us.tuʕ.ðiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اِسْتَعْذِينَ (istaʕḏīna) /is.taʕ.ðiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
